decision_source: User requested integration of latest D26 results, assumption review and D27

known_state.D26: COMPLETE 9/9; primary candidates failed original gate
known_state.D27: original attempt technical failure 0/10; repaired source ready, rerun not observed

phases.implementation_status: PROTOCOL_AND_CASE_MATRIX_ONLY; evaluator not yet implemented or queued
phases.checkpoint_selection: original frozen selection only; selected SHA bound before first D28 forward; no substitution if missing
phases.availability: both present; stress support masks not model inputs

recipes.rgb: local contrast attenuation about full-tile per-channel mean
recipes.dsm: local normalized height bias then clamp[0,1]

phases.generation: label-free per-tile balanced shuffled 16x16 blocks; two disjoint masks of floor(H*W/4) pixels; partial last block raster fill, exact area persisted
phases.bias_sign: tile-keyed deterministic + or - independent of labels and model
phases.generation_location: after frozen input normalization, full tile before sliding windows
phases.formula: 7 models * 2 recipes * 2 severities * 4 support pairs * 2 tiles
phases.weighting: sum raw integer matrices over tiles and equally over regime's support pairs, then compute IoU; do not average pair/tile IoUs for pooled
phases.clean_control: one clean per model per tile; reuse only if binding and evaluator input/geometry/precision match, otherwise add at most14 tile evaluations
phases.readiness_gate: D27 required completed checkpoints bound, no live overlapping workers; incomplete slots marked missing, no checkpoint replacements

hypothesis_gate.meaning: development engineering screen, not statistical significance or proof of natural correlated failures

transfer_gate.meaning: loss of gain under shared errors is a diagnostic; not automatically attributable to routing

candidate_gain_gate.meaning: candidate must also pass original D27 gate; cannot revive failed original claim

phases.type: not authorized or implemented new training
phases.activate_only: D27 valid mechanism and D28 reproducible target problem, frozen final plan before launch
phases.design: 2x2 independent/correlated augmentation x static/dynamic routing; identical experts, expert pool, loss, parameters, training age
phases.default_comparison: S1 vs G1 with identical protection/recovery and expert auxiliary losses; if local chosen, static vs local with same losses
phases.unseen_failure_boundary: training-unseen is distinct from development-unseen; reserve a failure family before training, do not call already-read Val2 an independent final
stop_conditions: simple correlated augmentation fully explains gain
harm reduction sacrifices both unique information paths
